sources.title: Glenn Barnich, Friedemann Brandt, and Marc Henneaux, Local BRST cohomology in gauge theories
sources.locator: Complete 150-page PDF retrieved; targeted complete reading of §§2.2–2.3 (PDF pp. 5–9) and §§4.1–4.5 (PDF pp. 22–27). The source treats Yang–Mills-type local gauge fields, finite-jet local functions, BRST cohomology, and H(s|d). It excludes extra matter gauge symmetries in the stated Yang–Mills-type setup; this page imports no later cohomology-classification theorem.

contents.name: Yang–Mills-type BRST fields, transformations, grading, and nilpotence
contents.support: Sections 2.2–2.3 give a non-Abelian local gauge/ghost convention, ghost grading, and the square-zero BRST differential. The new local definition fixes its own bracket order and does not copy the paper's sign without translation.

contents.name: Local functions and finite jet spaces
contents.support: Section 4.1 defines local functions as depending on spacetime and finitely many field derivatives, with commuting derivative indices. The item gives this finite-jet algebra explicitly.

contents.name: Relative local BRST cohomology modulo the horizontal differential
contents.support: Sections 2.3 and 4.2–4.5 give local forms, the horizontal differential, and the equations sa+dm=0 and a=sb+dn. The item defines the corresponding bidegree quotient directly and imports no classification theorem.

sources.title: Joaquim Gomis, Jordi París, and Stuart Samuel, Antibracket, Antifields and Gauge-Theory Quantization
sources.locator: Complete 196-page PDF retrieved; targeted complete reading of §3.2 (PDF pp. 27–30), §§4.1–4.6 (PDF pp. 48–58), and §5.2 (PDF pp. 61–66). The canonical bracket formulas, shifted Jacobi identity, minimal Yang–Mills master-action example, and nilpotence derivation were inspected. Its convention defines δ_B X=(X,S); this page instead states sX=(S,X) and fixes the induced sign convention explicitly.

searches.outcome: Found the full arXiv PDF and inspected the Yang–Mills and classical field–antifield sections.

contents.name: Non-Abelian Yang–Mills gauge algebra and minimal master-action data
contents.support: Sections 3.2 and 5.2 specify the closed irreducible Yang–Mills field/ghost content and antifield couplings. The new item defines the local candidate conditionally and does not infer a quantum theory.

contents.name: Canonical antibracket, classical master equation, and BRST nilpotence
contents.support: Sections 4.2–4.6 state the shifted bracket identities and derive nilpotence from the classical master equation. The new proof also establishes the converse under its explicit no-ghost-number-one-center hypothesis.

contents.name: Yang–Mills master-equation calculation and convention comparison
contents.support: Section 5.2 writes the minimal Yang–Mills BV action and expands (S,S); its ghost order and Hamiltonian side are compared against this item's declared convention.

contents.name: Canonical coordinate action of antifield terms
contents.support: Sections 4.2 and 4.6 specify the right/left derivative antibracket and field-coordinate BRST action generated by a master functional; the new finite-coordinate proof derives the sign for the explicitly chosen (S,-) ordering.
